about.headline: Bathrooms designed around your space, tiled with care.
about.body: A lot of Blue Mountains homes are older, with tight bathrooms and surprises behind the wall. We help you plan the layout, handle the waterproofing and tiling, and keep the house clean while we work.

process.headline: We listen. Plan it with you. Tile it right.

steps.title: On time, kept updated

steps.body: A final walk-through and a clean-up so the room's ready to use.

realReviews.author: Whitney and Luke Keir
realReviews.text:
Scott and his team recently renovated our bathroom and I cannot rate them highly enough. They showed up on time, treated our home with respect and their craftsmanship in such a small space was outstanding. They vacuumed every single day and kept us updated along the way without me chasing for updates. Scott also made plenty of helpful suggestions on how we could maximise our space and the result is unreal.
Scott was the tiler on our previous bathroom Reno at our old place and I am so thrilled to recommend him for any renovation work you need done. We will only use him and his team going forward.

realReviews.author: Robert Leslie
realReviews.text: I would highly recommend Scott and his team for your renovations project. Scott renovated our bathroom and laundry and did an amazing job that transformed the house. We weren’t really sure what would work and Scott had great advice and design ideas to maximise the use of the space. The team adapted with ease to some unforeseen problems with our 60 year old house and made everything work beautifully. The quality of the craftsmanship was second to none and Scott added some really nice finishing touches that enhanced the project. A big thank you to Scott and his team for a fantastic job!

realReviews.author: Andy Welch
realReviews.text: Scott and his team have just completed the renovation of our laundry / bathroom.  The whole process from start to finish has been a pleasure and the end result is better than we had imagined.  All the tradies Scott used were amazing.  I would highly recommend Scott for any bathroom or laundry Reno

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your bathroom?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits. You'll get a clear quote before anything's booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straight chat about your space.

faq.a: Send the job through the form with a few photos, or give us a ring. We'll come out, look at the space, talk through ideas and give you a clear quote.
We're based in Hazelbrook and work across the Blue Mountains, out to Lithgow, Penrith and Emu Plains. Not sure if you're in range? Ask anyway.
Yes. Waterproofing is handled as part of bathroom and laundry renovations, done properly before the tiles go down.
Ask when you request your quote and we'll send the licence and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: Can you just do the tiling?
faq.a: Yes. Tiling-only jobs are welcome: floors, splashbacks, outdoor areas, fireplace hearths and new builds.
